title: Enter into Italy
intro: Drive from Kamnik to Venice and park once at Autorimessa Comunale in Piazzale Roma. Explore the historic center entirely on foot: cross the smaller canals toward Rialto Bridge and the Grand Canal, continue to St. Mark's Square, admire the exterior of Doge's Palace and see the Bridge of Sighs, then return through Venice's streets to the same parking garage. Stop for a quick pizza or sandwich along the way. No vaporetto or paid sightseeing is planned; allow around 2.5–3 hours including parking, walking, photographs and food.
